user_story: As a user, I want to filter tasks by priority so that I can work on the most urgent items first.

positive.title: Filter tasks by high priority
steps: Navigate to the task list page
Click on the priority filter dropdown
Select 'High' from the priority options
Verify that the tasks displayed are filtered by high priority
positive.expected_result: Only tasks marked as 'High' priority are displayed on the task list

positive.title: Filter tasks by medium priority
steps: Navigate to the task list page
Click on the priority filter dropdown
Select 'Medium' from the priority options
Verify that the tasks displayed are filtered by medium priority
positive.expected_result: Only tasks marked as 'Medium' priority are displayed on the task list

positive.title: Filter tasks by low priority
steps: Navigate to the task list page
Click on the priority filter dropdown
Select 'Low' from the priority options
Verify that the tasks displayed are filtered by low priority
positive.expected_result: Only tasks marked as 'Low' priority are displayed on the task list

negative.title: Filter tasks with an invalid priority option
steps: Navigate to the task list page
Attempt to enter an invalid priority value in the filter dropdown
Apply the filter
negative.expected_result: The system displays an error message or does not apply any filter

negative.title: Filter tasks by priority when there are no tasks
steps: Navigate to the task list page with no tasks available
Click on the priority filter dropdown
Select any priority option
Verify the result
negative.expected_result: The system displays a message indicating no tasks are available or simply shows an empty task list

edge.title: Filter tasks by priority with mixed priorities
steps: Navigate to the task list page
Have a mix of tasks with various priorities (High, Medium, Low)
Click on the priority filter dropdown
Select 'High' priority
Verify that only tasks with High priority are displayed
edge.expected_result: The task list only shows tasks with High priority, other priority tasks are hidden

edge.title: Filter tasks by priority with identical priorities
steps: Navigate to the task list page
Ensure all tasks have the same priority, such as 'Medium'
Click on the priority filter dropdown
Select 'Medium' priority
Verify that all tasks are displayed
edge.expected_result: All tasks are displayed as they all have the same selected priority
